seo.title: Homeless and housing-crisis help in Provo - No Home Help
seo.description: Current Provo contacts for emergency shelter routes, meals, day services, health care, benefits, jobs, legal help and specialist support.

page.heading: Homeless and housing-crisis help in Provo
page.urgent: Immediate danger, serious injury, overdose, fire or a crime in progress: call 911. Mental-health or substance-use crisis: call or text 988. Community referrals: call 211.
page.notice: Utah County does not have a general year-round walk-in overnight shelter. Motel vouchers, warming-center services and housing programs are limited and eligibility-based. Call before travelling. No listing guarantees a room, bed, housing, appointment, benefit, payment, treatment or job.
page.intro: For a place to sleep, start with Community Action during business hours; after hours use the Provo dispatch route shown below. Food & Care Coalition is the main local day-service hub but is not a general walk-in overnight shelter. If one option cannot help, ask for the next safe local or regional alternative.
page.footer: No Home Help is independent of government and service providers. Information was checked against official provider or government pages; report a change if a number, address or access rule is no longer correct.

entries.title: 911 — emergency services
entries.description: Call for immediate danger, serious injury, suspected overdose, fire or a crime in progress. Give the exact address or nearest intersection and describe the immediate risk.
entries.how_to_access: Call 911. Do not use a shelter or crisis-line number instead when someone needs an ambulance, fire response or immediate police help.

entries.title: Provo dispatch — after-hours emergency-shelter screening
entries.description: After-hours contact used by Community Action for limited, eligibility-based motel shelter in Utah County. A call does not guarantee a motel room or transport.
entries.how_to_access: Call during the published after-hours window. If screened as eligible, follow the dispatch instructions and visit Community Action the next business day.

entries.title: Utah 211 — community-service referrals
entries.description: Statewide information and referral for food, housing, health care, transportation, legal help, benefits and other local programs. A navigator can search for more than one current option.
entries.how_to_access: Call 211 or use the online directory. Ask the navigator to confirm eligibility, hours and whether an appointment is required.

entries.title: Wasatch Behavioral Health Receiving and Outreach Center
entries.description: Walk-in crisis evaluation and brief support for adults in Utah and Wasatch counties, with therapists and peer specialists and access to mobile crisis outreach when appropriate. Adults may stay for short-term stabilisation, but this is not a homeless shelter.
entries.how_to_access: Walk in or call. Call or text 988 for telephone crisis support, and call 911 for immediate danger or a medical emergency.

entries.title: Community Action — limited motel shelter
entries.description: Short-term hotel placement for eligible families, couples and vulnerable individuals because Utah County has no general full-time shelter. Placements are limited, case-by-case and usually one to three nights; identification is required.
entries.address: 815 S Freedom Boulevard, Suite 100, Provo, UT 84601
entries.hours: Office Monday–Friday 08:00–16:00; use Provo dispatch after hours
entries.how_to_access: Call or visit for screening. Bring identification if available. Ask what to do if vouchers are exhausted and whether a winter warming center is operating.

entries.title: Food & Care Coalition — housing assessment and programs
entries.description: Case managers assess people for transitional and permanent housing and other housing support. This is not a guaranteed same-night bed and program openings are limited.
entries.hours: Call or visit during business hours
entries.how_to_access: Ask client services for housing intake and an individual case-management assessment. Continue using the Community Action emergency route while waiting for a program opening.

entries.title: The Refuge Utah — confidential emergency shelter
entries.description: Short-term confidential shelter for adults and children of all genders experiencing domestic or sexual violence, with food, clothing, advocacy, counselling and housing support. The location is not public.
entries.address: Confidential shelter location in Utah County
entries.how_to_access: Call from a safe device if possible. Ask about space, safe transport, accessibility, children and pets. Call 911 for immediate danger.

entries.title: Vantage Point — crisis shelter care for youth ages 10 to 17
entries.description: Twenty-four-hour crisis residential support for youth ages 10 to 17 who are runaways, at risk of running away or facing serious family conflict. This is a youth crisis service, not general adult shelter.
entries.how_to_access: Call for screening and current availability. For immediate danger call 911; for a mental-health crisis call or text 988.

entries.title: Food & Care Coalition — daily hot meals
entries.description: Hot meals every day of the year. The dining hall is open to anyone who is hungry, with no appointment, identification or paperwork required for a meal.
entries.hours: Monday–Saturday breakfast, lunch and dinner; Sunday and holidays lunch; confirm current serving times
entries.how_to_access: Walk in during meal service. Call before a long journey to confirm the next serving time.

entries.title: Community Action Services and Food Bank — food pantry
entries.description: Food pantry and case-management help for eligible Utah County residents, plus referrals to other food resources. Distribution rules and frequency limits apply.
entries.address: 815 S Freedom Boulevard, Suite 100, Provo, UT 84601
entries.hours: Call for current pantry and intake hours
entries.how_to_access: Call or complete the provider's intake process. Ask what identification or address information is needed and whether same-day food is available.

entries.title: Utah Food Bank — find another pantry or mobile distribution
entries.description: Official locator for partner pantries and mobile food distributions. Partner locations set their own hours and eligibility rules.
entries.address: Use the official locator for the nearest site
entries.how_to_access: Search by address or ZIP code, then call the chosen site to confirm the next distribution, documents and service limits.

entries.title: Food & Care Coalition — integrated day services
entries.description: Local day-service hub combining meals, showers, laundry, hygiene items, case management, health care, mental-health support, housing help and education at one address.
entries.hours: Call or visit during business hours; meal hours differ
entries.how_to_access: Walk in and ask the client-services manager to complete program intake and identify the services you can use that day.

entries.title: Community Thrift and Relief
entries.description: Community clothing and household-goods resource listed by Provo City. Stock, vouchers and eligibility may change.
entries.how_to_access: Call before visiting and ask whether a referral or voucher is needed for the item you need.

entries.title: Food & Care Coalition — showers, laundry and hygiene
entries.description: Showers, laundry and personal hygiene supplies for patrons. Appointments, sign-up times and daily capacity may apply.
entries.hours: Call or visit during regular business hours
entries.how_to_access: Ask client services for the current shower and laundry sign-up procedure. Arrive early and confirm how much laundry can be accepted.

entries.title: Community Thrift and Relief — clothing help
entries.description: Community resource for clothing and household necessities. Items and sizes depend on donations.
entries.how_to_access: Call before travelling and ask whether you need a referral, voucher or identification.

entries.title: East Bay Health Center — health care for people experiencing homelessness
entries.description: Medical and limited dental care inside the Food & Care Coalition building, with telehealth available. Appointment and walk-in capacity can change.
entries.how_to_access: Call for an appointment or ask Food & Care Coalition staff about same-day access. Call 911 for a life-threatening emergency.

entries.title: Mountainlands Provo Family Health Center
entries.description: Community health center providing primary care, dental, mental-health and pharmacy services. Ask about sliding-fee eligibility and required documents.
entries.hours: Medical Monday–Thursday 08:00–19:00, Friday 08:00–17:00, Saturday 08:00–13:30; other services differ
entries.how_to_access: Call the main number for medical and mental health or 801-429-2013 for dental. Ask about fees, insurance and the earliest appointment.

entries.title: Wasatch Behavioral Health — 24-hour crisis receiving center
entries.description: Immediate mental-health evaluation, peer support and short-term stabilisation for adults in Utah and Wasatch counties. Mobile crisis outreach can be arranged when appropriate.
entries.how_to_access: Walk in or call. Call or text 988 for crisis support; call 911 for immediate danger or medical emergency.

entries.title: Wasatch Behavioral Health — outpatient mental health and substance-use services
entries.description: Public community mental-health provider for Utah County offering therapy, case management, psychiatric and substance-use services. Eligibility, fees and wait times vary.
entries.how_to_access: Call for intake and explain insurance or Medicaid status. Use the Receiving and Outreach Center or 988 for an immediate crisis.

entries.title: Food & Care Coalition — indoor day services
entries.description: Indoor service hub with dining, toilets, showers, laundry, case management and connections to health and housing support. It is not a general overnight shelter.
entries.hours: Call or visit during business hours
entries.how_to_access: Walk in and ask the client-services manager for intake and the day's service schedule.

entries.title: Provo City Library — computers, Wi-Fi and printing
entries.description: Public library access to computers, internet and printing. Guest access, time limits and printing charges may apply.
entries.how_to_access: Ask staff about a guest computer session, Wi-Fi, charging and printing. Protect passwords and personal information on public computers.

entries.title: UTA Reduced Fare FAREPAY Card — Provo Central
entries.description: Reduced fares for qualifying low-income riders, people with disabilities, seniors and youth. Approval and identity or eligibility evidence are required.
entries.address: Provo Central Station, 701 S Freedom Boulevard, Provo, UT 84601
entries.how_to_access: Apply online or visit Provo Central with the required evidence. Ask a case manager for help obtaining documents if necessary.

entries.title: Utah Workforce Services — SNAP, medical and cash assistance
entries.description: Applications and eligibility support for SNAP, medical, financial and child-care assistance. Approval is based on program rules.
entries.how_to_access: Apply through myCase, by telephone or at the employment center. The initial SNAP application can be submitted before every verification document is available.

entries.title: Utah Workforce Services — Provo employment center
entries.description: Job search, employment counselling and possible training or education support for eligible jobseekers. Services do not guarantee a job.
entries.hours: Call for current lobby and appointment hours
entries.how_to_access: Apply online or visit the employment center. Ask for help creating an online account and explain if transportation, identification or internet access is a barrier.

entries.title: Food & Care Coalition — education and employment support
entries.description: Individual case management and educational programs can help patrons work toward employment and stability. Available activities and partner schedules vary.
entries.how_to_access: Complete client intake and ask for education, employment or benefits-related case management.

entries.title: Utah Legal Services — Provo civil legal aid
entries.description: Free civil legal help for eligible low-income Utah residents, including some housing, public-benefit, family and consumer matters. Representation is not guaranteed.
entries.address: 455 N University Avenue, Suite 100, Provo, UT 84601
entries.hours: Public office Tuesday–Thursday 09:00–15:00; additional hours by appointment
entries.how_to_access: Apply online or call intake before visiting. Explain any eviction, hearing or filing deadline immediately.

entries.title: Food & Care Coalition — mailing address for patrons
entries.description: Patrons may use the Coalition's address for essential correspondence, including employer, government and family contact. Ask staff how mail is labelled, collected and retained.
entries.how_to_access: Complete program intake before using the address. Confirm the exact name format, collection schedule and how long unclaimed mail is kept.

entries.title: The Refuge Utah — domestic and sexual violence helpline
entries.description: Confidential safety planning, advocacy, counselling and emergency shelter for people of all genders and family types affected by domestic or sexual violence.
entries.how_to_access: Call from a safe device if possible. Ask about emergency shelter, safe transport and support for children or pets. Call 911 for immediate danger.

entries.title: Wasatch Behavioral Health WATCH Homeless Services
entries.description: Behavioural-health and case-management support for people experiencing homelessness, based at the Food & Care Coalition campus. Program eligibility and availability vary.
entries.how_to_access: Call or ask Food & Care Coalition client services for a WATCH referral and intake information.

entries.title: Community Action — housing and self-sufficiency case management
entries.description: Assessment for emergency assistance, rental or deposit help, food and longer-term self-sufficiency services. Funding and eligibility are limited.
entries.address: 815 S Freedom Boulevard, Suite 100, Provo, UT 84601
entries.how_to_access: Complete the provider's intake and meet with a caseworker. Bring lease, eviction or income information if available, but call first if a deadline is near.

entries.title: VA — homeless veteran help
entries.description: VA help for veterans who are homeless or at risk, including shelter and housing referrals, health care, benefits, employment support and justice-system re-entry. Local care is coordinated through the Salt Lake City VA region.
entries.how_to_access: Call the national line or 801-582-1565 extension 2746. You do not need to prove eligibility before making the first call.

entries.title: Ruff Haven — regional temporary pet crisis care
entries.description: Salt Lake-based short-term shelter or foster care for dogs and cats when an owner faces a qualifying crisis. This is a regional option; space and transport are not guaranteed.
entries.address: Salt Lake City area; intake arranged after approval
entries.how_to_access: Apply online and explain the crisis, pet and transport situation. Ask a local case manager or The Refuge about nearer pet-safe options first.

entries.title: Provo City — community-resource directory
entries.description: City directory of food, housing, employment, health, legal and other community providers. Listings are a starting point; confirm details directly with each provider.
entries.how_to_access: Use the directory to identify another provider, then call that provider before travelling.
